title: Check registration IP risk
Consulta riesgo de IP
检查注册 IP 风险
Kiểm tra rủi ro IP
summary: Request IP risk signals for one authorized registration event and keep the decision in your application.
Consulta señales de riesgo IP para un registro autorizado y conserva la decisión en tu aplicación.
为一个获授权的注册事件查询 IP 风险信号，由你的应用决定后续动作。
Tra cứu tín hiệu rủi ro IP cho một sự kiện đăng ký được phép; ứng dụng của bạn quyết định bước tiếp theo.
inputs: Authorized public IP address, consent reference, stable request UUID and explicit trial or paid mode.
output: IP risk signals and available explanatory evidence for the event; not an identity or fraud verdict.
boundary: Requires current supplier readiness and an eligible merchant. Paid mode requires confirmed prepaid credit. A risk score alone must not approve or reject a person.
topics: Use an IP risk signal in signup without calling it identity verification
Keep an unavailable IP score separate from low risk
audience: SaaS signup, marketplace and fraud operations developers
